parameters.query: INSERT INTO agent_executions (project_id, agent_name, status) VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_regulatory', 'running') RETURNING id

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.project_type, p.location_city, p.location_province, p.property_type, p.property_area_m2, p.budget_target, c.name as client_name FROM projects p LEFT JOIN clients c ON c.id = p.client_id WHERE p.id = $1::uuid

SELECT id, option_number, title, description, intervention_logic, rooms_layout, technical_notes, conflict_points, pros, cons FROM design_options WHERE project_id = $1::uuid AND is_selected = true LIMIT 1
SELECT id, version, summary, client_needs, objectives, constraints, style_preferences, rooms_affected FROM briefings WHERE project_id = $1::uuid AND status = 'approved' ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT content, model_recommended, temperature FROM agent_prompts WHERE agent_name = 'agent_regulatory' AND prompt_type = 'system' AND is_active = true LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO regulatory_tasks (project_id, execution_id, exec_status, task_type, title, description, entity, required_docs, estimated_timeline, estimated_cost, priority, draft_message, notes, status, normativa_confidence, citation_source, normativa_fetched_at) VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, 'draft', $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::jsonb, $8, $9, $10, $11, $12, 'detected', $13, $14, NOW()) RETURNING id, task_type, priority, title

parameters.jsCode: const all = $input.all(); const pid = $('Receive Project').first().json.project_id; const tasks = all.map(i=>i.json); const tc = tasks.length; const cc = tasks.filter(t=>t.priority==='critico').length; return [{ json: { project_id: pid, tasks_count: tc, critical_count: cc, needs_external_contact: cc > 0, tasks_summary: tasks.map(t=>`[${t.priority}] ${t.title}`).join('\n') } }];

parameters.query: INSERT INTO approvals (project_id, approval_type, requested_by, context_data, status) VALUES ($1::uuid, 'external_contact', 'agent_regulatory', $2::jsonb, 'pending') RETURNING id

parameters.jsCode: const d = $input.first().json; const action = (d.query?.action || d.body?.action || 'reject').toLowerCase(); const data = $('Collect All Tasks').first().json; return [{ json: { action, is_approved: action === 'approve', project_id: data.project_id, tasks_count: data.tasks_count, critical_count: data.critical_count } }];

parameters.query: UPDATE regulatory_tasks SET status = 'confirmed' WHERE project_id = $1::uuid AND priority = 'critico'
UPDATE agent_executions SET status = 'completed', finished_at = now() WHERE id = $1::uuid; UPDATE regulatory_tasks SET exec_status = 'confirmed' WHERE execution_id = $1::uuid

INSERT INTO project_intelligence (project_id, agent_name, key, value) VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_regulatory', 'regulatory_intelligence', $2::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (project_id, agent_name, key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, updated_at = now()

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$json.project_id, JSON.stringify({ critical_count: $json.critical_count, tasks_count: $json.tasks_count, structural_risk: ($json.tasks_summary || '').toLowerCase().includes('estructur'), needs_external_contact: $json.needs_external_contact, tasks_summary: $json.tasks_summary })] }}

parameters.query: WITH _ts AS (SELECT set_config('app.current_tenant', COALESCE(resolve_tenant_from_project($1::uuid)::text, ''), false) AS s) SELECT q.value FROM (SELECT value FROM system_config WHERE key = 'architect_email') q, _ts
